about: Worked examples for the money rules every lane builds on. Amounts are in rupees, written as a receipt shows them. A share is given in basis points: 100 basis points is 1%, so 500 is 5% and 2000 is 20%. A share is rounded down to the paisa, and chip rounding is down to the nearest ₹50; nothing ever rounds up. The smallest chip on the floor is ₹50.

cases.description: Normal pot: 5% of ₹10,000 is ₹500.
Design prompt flow 4: 5% of a ₹48,000 pot is ₹2,400.
Design prompt flow 5: 5% of a ₹1,40,000 pot is ₹7,000, before the table's ₹6,000 cap is applied.
Zero: 5% of an empty pot is ₹0.
Paise round down, never up: 5% of ₹1.99 is 9.95 paise, which is ₹0.09.
Just off a ₹50 boundary: 5% of ₹48,990 is ₹2,449.50, before chip rounding.
Buy-in bonus Tuesday: 20% of a ₹10,000 buy-in is ₹2,000.
The whole amount: 100% (10,000 basis points) of ₹2,500 is ₹2,500.
Large amount, past what a floating-point number holds exactly: 5% of ₹10,00,00,00,00,00,001.01 is ₹50,00,00,00,00,000.05 after rounding down.
₹50 rounding: ₹2,449.50 rounds down to ₹2,400.
₹50 rounding: exactly on a chip, ₹2,450 stays ₹2,450.
₹50 rounding: one paisa short of a chip, ₹2,449.99 rounds down to ₹2,400.
₹50 rounding: one paisa past a chip, ₹2,450.01 rounds down to ₹2,450.
₹50 rounding: below the smallest chip, ₹49.99 rounds down to ₹0.
₹50 rounding: zero stays zero.
₹50 rounding of a large amount: ₹50,00,00,00,00,000.05 rounds down to ₹50,00,00,00,00,000.
A ₹5,000 buy-in can be paid in ₹50 chips.
₹5,025 cannot be paid in ₹50 chips.
₹50.01 cannot be paid in ₹50 chips.
₹0 needs no chips, so it counts as a whole number of them.
Design prompt flow 4: rake ₹2,400 plus a ₹100 jackpot drop is a pull of ₹2,500.
Design prompt flow 4: the ₹3,42,600 bad-beat jackpot plus a ₹100 drop is ₹3,42,700.
Adding zero changes nothing: ₹1,85,000 plus ₹0 is ₹1,85,000.
Design prompt flow 8: a ₹1,20,000 cash-out settles the ₹50,000 marker first, leaving ₹70,000.
Design prompt flow 3: a ₹1,85,000 balance less a ₹10,000 buy-in is ₹1,75,000.
Five buy-ins of ₹10,000 are ₹50,000.
RIVR Sunday: 58 entries of ₹9,000 to the pool are ₹5,22,000.
No entries are ₹0.
